name: The Feasting Season
description: The future shortens and shrinks as the Lord of the Feast stirs. Storehouses are cracked open, fields lie fallow, and soldiers help themselves to whatever is in reach. It is a time of indulgence and war.

choices.name: The Lord of the Feast
choices.description: The Lord of the Feast imbues target heroes and rulers with Feyblood, which empowers them and makes them more aggressive and gold-hungry. They can then be manipulated through powers to bring ruin to their neighbours.
